headline: CDPQ in Talks to Buy Stake in Bain's Bridge Data Centres
summary: Canadian institutional investor La Caisse de dépôt et placement du Québec is in discussions to acquire a minority stake in Singapore-headquartered Bridge Data Centres from Bain Capital.
why: Global pension funds are increasing allocations to digital real estate assets across the Asia-Pacific region to capture growing cloud and AI processing capacity demand.

impacts.name: Asia Data Centres
impacts.why: Institutional investment by CDPQ underlines strong sponsor demand for Asian digital assets.
